excerpt.zh: 无视败者的癫狂咆哮，[From.GetAdj]军队接管银河之星的仪式不过平淡无奇。
excerpt.en: Aside from numerous functionaries breaking down into hysterics during the handover, the surrendering of the Galatron to [From.GetAdj] forces was an uneventful affair.
